{{Quote|His name's Mixon Guncher. If you've heard of him, none of that stuff about his weird behavior is true. Well, not much. He does wear a lot of perfume.|[[Blerx Tango]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
'''Jakko Mixon''' , also known as '''Mixon Guncher''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] and [[slitherhorn]] player in a band called the [[Dewback Ramblers]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our slitherhorn player just arrived on Tatooine, but he got suckered by the old ""free transport to Bestine"" con game. He's stranded in the desert and needs an escort. Can you help?|Blerx Tango, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jakko Mixon and the Dewback Ramblers operated out of the [[Lucky Star (Mos Entha)|Lucky Star]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]], on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:BT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jakko Mixon fell for an old scam, where he believed he could get a cheap ride from someone to [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. Instead, Jakko ended up stranded in the desert. Fortunately for him, the leader of the band, [[Blerx Tango]], employed a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find Jakko and bring him back safely to Mos Entha.<ref name="SWG:BT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blerx Tando was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG:BT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, players doing a mission for Blerx Tango had to rescue Jakko.<ref name="SWG:BT" />

Though not mentioned in the quest dialogue, examining Jakko revealed him to also be a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]].
